message:
I was feeling pretty pleased with myself the other day. I remembered a little tip about checking the weather before heading out, especially during storm season. It led me to some great resources about flood safety and how to stay ahead of the game. A small win, but it meant I didn’t need to wade through any puddles on my way to the grocery store! 🌧️ 

What little tricks do you use to keep your family safe during storms?
